findings.semantics: Unreferenced local branches emit one impacting cause, not all exception paths. Swapping entity IDs alone changes the winner; reversing child order, timings, durations, or exception IDs does not in these captures. Entity ID pairs reject a simple ascending or descending lexical selection rule.

An inferred remote failure is selected ahead of a local exception even when the remote entity has no exceptions. Two inferred remote candidates still produce one impacting path. Changing only an inferred service name can change the winner; local-entity name changes do not in these captures. Inferred receiver exceptions remain empty and Remote remains false.

findings.semantics: Flag-only tails are omitted. The path terminates at the deepest actual exception owner; an empty intermediary remains when its descendant owns the selected exception. An unresolved child reference does not erase its ancestor exception cause.

References select an exception owner ahead of remote branch priority. An inferred receiver excluded by its parent reference is retained separately as a non-client-impacting inferred-only cause, including when the parent reference is unresolved.

selection_policy.native_guarantee: One actual path per causal traversal; reference ownership, inferred receiver projection, exception ownership, and client impact are retained. Multiple independent causal traversals can yield multiple root causes.
selection_policy.documented_contract: The primary API and developer documentation specify root-cause service/entity paths but promise no ordering among competing branches.
selection_policy.local_tie_order: The implementation deterministically chooses the first productive equal-priority child in the existing stable start-time/ID order. This is a local tie rule, not a reproduction or claim about the AWS ID/name-dependent ranking.
selection_policy.unresolved_vendor_detail: Exact equal-priority native winner depends on entity IDs and inferred service names. No AWS hash/ranking algorithm is inferred or fabricated.
selection_policy.replay_guidance: Exact comparison remains appropriate for unambiguous causes. For the listed equal-priority selections, assert one impacting cause, membership in actual eligible terminal entities, and complete path/exception/remote/inferred shape for the selected entity rather than pinning the opaque native winner.
